mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Graves has @f1@ bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

mBuff.mDescription: This unit has reduced Movement Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Graves gains increasing armor and magic resistance the longer he remains in combat.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Graves gains @TotalArmor@ bonus Armor and Magic Resist every second he remains in combat (stacks up to @PassiveMaxStacks@ times).

Graves is treated as in combat if he has dealt or taken damage in the last @BuffDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Graves dashes forward gaining an Attack Speed boost for several seconds. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Dashes forward, gaining <attackSpeed>@ASIncrease*100@% increased Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @BuffDuration@ seconds. Basic attacks lower the cooldown of <spellName>Quickdraw</spellName> by @CooldownPerHit@ second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Graves fires three bullets in a cone, damaging all enemies in their paths.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shoots three bullets in a cone, each dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to all enemies in their path. Enemies hit with multiple bullets take @ReducedDamage@ damage from each additional bullet.

"Tang! Tang! Tang! BANG!"

mLocKeys.keySummary: Graves fires an explosive shell that deals heavy damage to units it hits or passes through. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fires an explosive shell that deals <physicalDamage>@Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to enemies it hits or passes through. After hitting an enemy Champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes, dealing <physicalDamage>@FalloffDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> in a cone.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke. Enemies inside the smoke cloud have reduced sight range and Movement Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Deals  <magicDamage>@ImpactDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on impact and creates a smoke cloud that lasts @SmokeDuration@ seconds. Enemies inside the cloud are <status>Slowed</status> by @MovementSpeedMod*-1@% and have their sight radius reduced.
